# Midway Ventures LLC

> Rents one heated shop on US-310 just west of Lovell, Wyoming (Big Horn Basin): 36 x 45 ft floor (1,620 sq ft), 16 ft ceilings, a private bathroom and a private office. Rent online.

## Shop facts (as of November 2026)
- Size: 36 ft wide x 45 ft deep x 16 ft tall inside; 1,620 sq ft
- Heated: yes
- Private bathroom: yes
- Private office: yes
- Base rent: $1,250 per month before payment fees (the rental page adds about 1.75% for ACH or about 4% for card)
- Status at last check: open to rent
- Office size: not published yet
- Overhead door: not published yet
- Power: not published yet
- Access hours: not published yet
- Lease term: not published yet

## Business facts
- Name: Midway Ventures LLC
- Address: 1781 US Highway 310, Lovell, WY 82431
- Phone: (307) 272-7444
- Rent online or join a waitlist: https://midwayventuresllc.ccstorage.com/find_units/loc_b07c6c20aebd052257591ce9104c7cea
